review_candidates.title: Global Foundations Manager
review_candidates.description: Career Opportunities: Global Foundations Manager (14162) Requisition ID 14162 - Posted 10/09/2026 - Nairobi - Full Time  Job Description Print Preview Are you looking for a meaningful job where you can invest your skills, passion, and time in an impactful way? Do you want to work for an organization that is dynamic, goal-driven, and dedicated to making a difference? Welcome to Welthungerhilfe! Welthungerhilfe (WHH) is one of Germany’s largest private aid organizations. Politically and religiously independent, we work toward a world without hunger. Together with national and international partners, we respond to humanitarian crises and support long-term solutions that improve the living conditions for the most vulnerable people. We change and shape food systems, we are locally-led and globally connected. As an impact-oriented and human-centered organization, we use innovation, evidence and data-informed decision-making to continuously improve our work and contribute to #Zero Hunger. Our vision: "Zero Hunger on a Healthy Planet." Join us in creating a world where everyone has access to food while ensuring a sustainable future for our planet. If you are ready to make an impact, we look forward to receiving your application! Global Foundations Manager* in one of the WHH country offices in the African continent The position is to be filled as soon as possible, with an initial contract duration of 2 years. There are very good prospects for an extension. The role is based in one of the WHH country offices in the African continent and will work with WHH country offices worldwide. Candidates should apply for a duty station in a country where they are currently legally authorized to work without employer-sponsored work authorization. Please note that the position does not offer visa or work permit sponsorship. The final duty station will be based on the selected candidate’s existing right to work in the respective country. As Global Foundations Manager, you will help diversify Welthungerhilfe’s funding base and strengthen long-term philanthropic partnerships that advance our mission of Zero Hunger. The role combines partnership development, internal collaboration, and strategic fundraising. You will develop and manage strategic foundation partnerships and work closely with country offices to establish the processes and structures that enable foundation fundraising. Working closely with colleagues across country offices and the German headquarter, including colleagues already engaging with foundation donors (mainly in Germany and USA), you will contribute to building strong foundation pipelines, developing compelling partnership opportunities, and strengthening approaches to foundation engagement across countries. Alongside this work, you will also develop and pursue selected foundation partnerships directly, particularly with foundations operating regionally or locally in countries where Welthungerhilfe works. In doing so, you will coordinate closely with colleagues worldwide to ensure aligned engagement and a coherent global approach to donor relationships. You will be part of WHH’s Philanthropy & Partnerships team, which is primarily based in Germany, collaborating virtually on a regular basis across time zones. Your responsibilities Work closely with country offices to identify, develop, and advance strategic foundation partnership opportunities. Collaborate with country teams in building and managing strong foundation prospect pipelines, identifying opportunities that align with programmatic priorities and funding strategies. Accompany country offices in the cultivation and development of foundation partnerships, including donor outreach strategies, engagement planning, and partnership positioning. Contribute to developing partnership pitches, concepts, and cases for support together with country teams, translating programmatic priorities and impact evidence into compelling foundation-facing propositions. Facilitate exchange of successful practices, market insights, and fundraising approaches across country offices to strengthen the organization’s overall capacity to engage foundations. Identify and pursue selected strategic foundation opportunities, particularly with regional or locally present foundations, in close coordination with relevant country offices and head office colleagues. Coordinate closely with WHH colleagues wordwide to ensure aligned relationship management and coordinated donor engagement. Develop high-quality pitches, concept notes, proposals, and partnership propositions in collaboration with technical experts, program and country teams. Support due diligence processes and risk assessments for prospective foundation partners in line with Welthungerhilfe’s policies and compliance requirements. Your profile A Bachelor’s degree required; a Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Development Studies, Marketing, or Communications) is strongly preferred. At least five years of progressive experience in foundation fundraising or institutional philanthropy, ideally within an international NGO or global development context. Demonstrated ability to secure six- and seven-figure grants from foundations and manage long-term donor relationships. Strong analytical and strategic skills to translate complex programmatic information into compelling, impact-driven funding propositions. Experience using donor relationship management systems (e.g., Salesforce or equivalent) to maintain a structured partner pipeline and monitor engagement. Excellent interpersonal and networking skills with the ability to build trust and collaborate effectively across cultures, functions, and levels of seniority. High degree of independence, organization, and reliability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment. Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and adapt strategies to evolving philanthropic trends. You recognize the growing value of data in your field and are eager to build your awareness and skills to incorporate data-informed approaches into your work. Exceptional written and verbal English skills, with proven ability to develop persuasive, donor-oriented proposals and reports. Proficiency in additional languages is an asset. What we offer Fair Compensation: A fair and equal remuneration based on a transparent salary scale. Commitment to Well-Being: We attach great importance to our duty of care with a focus on safety, security & health. Modern & Agile Work Environment: Be part of a forward thinking organization that fully embraces digitalization and innovation across all areas. Personal & Professional Growth: Access diverse learning and development opportunities to advance your career. Team: Join our dedicated and diverse teams, where passion, expertise, and joy come together to create a better world. In addition, Welthungerhilfe offers numerous other benefits, which you can find under Our benefits . Please send your application via our online recruiting system by October 27, 2026. Your contact person is Sarah Liem-Hartmann. Welthungerhilfe is committed to fighting terrorism in all its activities. Accordingly, any applicant who is offered employment will be screened against lists of known and suspected terrorists. Welthungerhilfe values diversity and ensures an inclusive, non-discriminatory working environment. We welcome applications from suitably qualified people from all sections of the community. Our Benefits Find Out What Benefits Welthungerhilfe Offers For Employees. Our Projects We fight against hunger and poverty by implementing projects in numerous countries. Our Strategy "Zero Hunger on a Healthy Planet" Our strategy guides us in our work. Transparency and Quality Welthungerhilfe, its employees, as well as its partners commit to transparency and quality. review_candidates.description: About CMIE CMIE, or Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy Pvt Ltd, is India’s leading economics and business analysis institution in India. It was established in 1976. Analysts at CMIE command an exceptional grasp of data. Their analysis is steeply rooted in evidence. We speak with confidence and are received with respect. CMIE is the only company in India that has a presence over the entire economic and business information food-chain – from large scale primary data collection, secondary data aggregation and information product development through analysis and forecasting. CMIE has built India's largest database on the financial performance of individual companies; it conducts India’s largest household survey; it runs a unique monitoring of new investment projects on hand and it has created the largest integrated database of the Indian economy. It provides services to the entire spectrum of business information consumers including governments, academia, financial markets, business enterprises, professionals and media. How to Apply If you are ambitious and look forward to work on the magic of Prowess, this is the right place to be in. Please submit your resume with your current CTC (if applicable) to ataskar@cmie.com . Applications will be accepted only through email. Include "Financial Analyst - Prowess" in the subject line of your email. We will contact selected candidates for the next steps of the recruitment process. Only CA candidates apply . Role Overview This role sits at the intersection of corporate accounting standards and financial data engineering. This position is designed for an analytically driven expert looking to apply their accounting expertise into the development of a robust corporate financial database rather than pursuing traditional auditing. You will transform disparate corporate reporting into highly structured, standardized database, directly impacting the analytical capabilities of top-tier financial institutions, researchers, and corporates. It offers a unique career path to drive data engineering logic from a core accounting perspective. Key Responsibilities Identify and analyze relevant datasets and corporate disclosures with a view to create an effective database that best supports various real-time use cases and analytical applications. Deeply study and analyze financial and non-financial disclosures across multiple accounting frameworks (IGAAP, Ind AS) applicable to diverse industries. Build and maintain standardised schemas to unify and map divergent reporting practices across accounting formats applicable to banking, financial, & non-financial corporate structures. Stay abreast of regulatory disclosure mandates and updated accounting frameworks to proactively align the database schema with evolving corporate disclosure practices. Implement stringent mathematical and logical validation rules to prevent or eliminate data errors to ensure flawless database integrity. Establish precise data-capturing practices across reporting formats to maintain consistent semantic definitions and preserve line-item integrity, ensuring absolute analytical accuracy for end-user financial analysis. Document structured financial metadata, line-item histories, and accounting treatment frameworks to establish a formal knowledge base that guides database operations and empowers clients with critical analytical context. Design, monitor, and continuously refine the operational workflows to drive processing efficiency and maintain flawless database standards. Leverage expertise in ratio analysis, peer bench-marking, and other evaluation techniques to contribute to the development of refined ratios and algorithms to enable superior analysis. Understand CMIE's financial and non-financial databases on companies and the delivery of this information to various segments of the financial markets. Skills & Qualifications Candidates must have cleared at least CA Intermediate (both groups) or ACCA Applied Skills (with Financial Reporting), with advanced preference for CA Finalists (Group 1 cleared), Qualified CAs, or ACCA Affiliates/Member Strong understanding of corporate reporting frameworks and disclosure practices across IGAAP and Ind AS Accounting Standards Familiarity with corporate governance guidelines issued by regulators such as the RBI, SEBI, or MCA Ability to interpret financial and non-financial information in the context of varied analytical use-cases Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to the stakeholders effectively Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills Numeracy, the ability to deal with numbers, conduct time-series analysis and basic principles of statistics is essential. Skills in R Programming, Advanced Excel, Python or similar system will be beneficial Compensation & additional benefits The compensation is commensurate with the capabilities. CMIE is growing rapidly. If you are ambitious and look forward to work on the magic of Prowess, this is the right place to be in.

review_candidates.title: Construction Manager
review_candidates.description: About Us Stimulus Technologies is a leader in technology services, dedicated to bridging the digital divide in underserved communities. With operations across California, Missouri, Nevada, New Mexico, and Oregon, we deliver high-speed, reliable connectivity that transforms lives and businesses. We also offer IT, VoIP, and Cybersecurity services to a range of clients. Position Overview As the owner's representative in the field, the Construction Manager holds direct authority over all field construction activities across Stimulus's broadband and fiber projects. This includes managing Stimulus-employed Resident Engineers, overseeing third-party contractors, and serving as the primary point of accountability between field operations, the engineering firm, and the project management team. Deployment projects include: BDP and BEAD-funded fiber deployments across Oregon, with hard regulatory timelines and high visibility. The Construction Manager is the person who ensures those commitments are met, safely, on schedule, within budget, and to spec. For the right candidate, this is a rare chance to join a growth-stage broadband company at an inflection point, bring genuine expertise to a team that will act on it, and build something that lasts. Essential Functions Construction Oversight Oversee all phases of OSP fiber optic construction including aerial, underground, and buried plant installation. Ensure construction activities comply with project plans, specifications, permits, and applicable codes and standards. Conduct regular site visits to verify construction quality, safety compliance, and adherence to project timelines. Manage contractor performance and hold construction crews accountable to contract terms and workmanship standards. Review and approve contractor pay applications, change orders, and project closeout documentation. Ensure construction contractors and sub-contractors adhere to 811 rules and regulations. Coordinate with the Permitting Manager to ensure all required permits and approvals are in place prior to construction. Identify and resolve field conflicts, constructability issues, and design discrepancies in coordination with the engineering firm. Monitor project budgets and forecasts; escalate cost or schedule risks to the VP of Engineering promptly. Ensure all as-built documentation is accurate, complete, and delivered on schedule. Manage day-to-day relationships with construction partners, subcontractors, and material vendors; hold each accountable to contractual terms, delivery schedules, and quality expectations while serving as the field-level escalation point for vendor performance issues. Engineering Firm Oversight Serve as Stimulus Technologies’ owner’s representative in all field interactions with the contracted engineering firm. Oversee Resident Engineers and field inspectors provided by the engineering firm; ensure their work product, conduct, and performance meet Stimulus Technologies standards and expectations. Review and approve the engineering firm’s inspection reports, daily logs, and as-built documentation before acceptance into Stimulus records. Monitor the engineering firm’s compliance with their SOW, contract terms, and agreed-upon deliverable schedules. Review the engineering firm’s construction-ready design packages (HLD, MLD, construction drawings) and validate they meet Stimulus network standards, material specifications, and preferred vendor requirements before releasing to construction. Coordinate with the engineering firm on design revisions, field change orders, and constructability issues that arise during construction. Escalate engineering firm performance concerns, resource shortfalls, or quality issues to the VP of Engineering with documented specifics and recommended corrective actions. Participate in the acceptance and turnover process from construction into Stimulus Technologies operations and NOC, ensuring all network elements are documented, tested, and ready for service activation. Team Leadership Directly manage and mentor Stimulus-employed Resident Engineers assigned to active projects. Conduct regular performance check-ins, provide constructive feedback, and support professional development for direct reports. Set clear expectations, priorities, and deliverables for the field inspection team across both Stimulus and engineering firm personnel. Coordinate staffing and resource allocation across multiple concurrent construction projects; communicate resource needs to the VP of Engineering. Foster a team culture aligned with Stimulus Technologies core values, particularly Extreme Ownership and Elevate Others. Safety and Compliance Enforce compliance with all federal, state, and local safety regulations on every job site for both Stimulus and engineering firm field personnel. Conduct or oversee safety audits and ensure corrective actions are implemented immediately. Ensure all field personnel – Stimulus-employed and engineering firm – maintain required safety certifications and training. Lead incident investigations and root cause analyses; implement lessons learned across the team. Communication and Reporting Provide regular construction status updates to the VP of Engineering and Project Management. Facilitate weekly construction meetings with contractors, Resident Engineers, engineering firm representatives, and project stakeholders. Maintain accurate project records including daily logs, inspection reports, production metrics, and issue trackers. Serve as the escalation point for field-level disputes, contractor issues, and client concerns. Provide details to the VP of Engineering and Project Management on all required construction activities for each of the state and federal grant programs. Education and Experience Required High school diploma or GED; bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or related field preferred. Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in OSP telecom or fiber optic construction. Minimum 3 years in a supervisory or management role overseeing field construction teams. Strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction methods including aerial, underground, and buried applications. Strong understanding of RUS construction standards, NESC requirements, and industry best practices. Demonstrated ability to manage contractors, budgets, and schedules across multiple concurrent projects. Experience managing or coordinating with third-party engineering firms and their field personnel. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management or construction tracking tools. Valid driver’s license with the ability to travel extensively to project sites. Ability to work in all weather conditions and navigate active construction environments. Preferred Familiarity with FTTH/FTTP construction and deployment at scale. Background in OSP engineering or fiber network design. OSHA 30-Hour Construction certification. Experience with GIS-based construction documentation and as-built management tools. Experience with network acceptance testing and turnover to operations. Alignment with Core Values At Stimulus Technologies, our core values define how we work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate: Driven to Grow – Continuously seeks to develop professionally, stays current with industry practices, and pushes to improve processes and outcomes. See a Need – Fill a Need – Proactively identifies gaps, obstacles, or opportunities and takes action without waiting to be asked. Elevate Others – Mentors teammates, shares knowledge freely, and actively contributes to a positive and collaborative work environment. Extreme Ownership – Takes full accountability for results, decisions, and mistakes; does not deflect blame or make excuses. Celebrate Success – Recognizes contributions of team members, acknowledges milestones, and fosters a culture where wins are shared. Stimulus Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Management reserves the right to amend and change responsibilities to meet business and organizational needs as necessary.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Xionex supports banks, insurers, and enterprises in reducing costs, accelerating back‑office processes, and improving operational quality through governed AI and specialized vertical AI agents. The company combines deep domain expertise with a high‑performance global service‑delivery model to help organizations modernize operations. By focusing on robust governance and industry-specific solutions, Xionex enables clients to unlock new efficiency and risk‑management opportunities. Team members work at the intersection of financial services, technology, and compliance, contributing to scalable, future‑ready operations. Role Description The Compliance Officer Fin Crime role is a full-time hybrid position based in Hannover, with the flexibility to work from home part of the time. In this role, the individual will monitor and assess financial crime risks, including money laundering, fraud, and sanctions breaches, and support the implementation of effective controls in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements. Daily tasks include reviewing alerts and cases, performing investigations and enhanced due diligence, documenting findings, and preparing clear reports for internal stakeholders and, where necessary, regulatory bodies. The role involves advising business units on financial crime compliance, contributing to policy and procedure development, and supporting training initiatives to build awareness of financial crime risks. Collaboration with risk, legal, and operational teams is expected to ensure continuous improvement of systems, processes, and AI-enabled tools used in financial crime detection and prevention. Qualifications Strong skills in Compliance Management and Regulatory Compliance, with experience in financial crime frameworks and controls. Solid Analytical Skills and the ability to interpret complex data, transaction patterns, and risk indicators. Effective Communication skills, including clear written reporting and the ability to explain complex compliance topics to diverse stakeholders. Knowledge of Finance and financial products, preferably within banking, insurance, or related financial services. Experience in anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF), sanctions screening, or fraud prevention is highly beneficial. Familiarity with using technology and data tools (e.g., case management systems, analytics platforms, AI-supported monitoring tools) in compliance work. Bachelor’s degree in law, finance, business, economics, or a related field; relevant professional certifications (e.g., CAMS, ICA) are an advantage. Ability to work in a hybrid environment, manage priorities independently, and maintain high ethical standards and attention to detail.

review_candidates.description: Responsibilities: Project Management: Oversee the full lifecycle of EV charging station projects in Europe, from initiation, design, procurement, construction, commissioning to handover and O&M, ensuring timely, quality, and budget-compliant delivery. Progress, Quality & Safety Control: Develop and execute detailed schedules, track key milestones, manage quality checkpoints, and enforce safe and compliant on-site construction practices per international engineering standards and local regulations. Technical Solutions & Support: Lead technical solution review and optimization, provide on-site guidance, and resolve complex challenges related to local processes, policies, regulations, and site conditions. Team & Resource Coordination: Organize and manage on-site crews, subcontractors, and suppliers; allocate manpower and equipment efficiently; collaborate closely with domestic and international teams to ensure compliance, budget alignment, and company interests. Stakeholder Communication: Maintain close liaison with overseas clients, local authorities, supervision units, and property owners; address on-site issues to ensure smooth project acceptance and customer satisfaction. Risk Identification & Mitigation: Identify potential risks, develop and implement contingency plans, monitor continuously, and make swift decisions under emergencies to safeguard project safety and progress. Documentation & Deliverables: Prepare and archive progress reports, quality inspection records, as-built documents, settlement files, etc., ensuring completeness and traceability. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Energy & Power Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related fields. 5+ years of project management or on-site construction experience, including at least 3 years in EV charging (or new energy power) projects. Successfully led 3+ complete charging station projects preferred. Familiar with local European construction codes and regulations, as well as the full installation, commissioning, and acceptance process for EV chargers. Knowledge of IEC 61851 and other international charging standards. Proficient in project management tools (MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint) and design software (CAD, BIM). Competent in budgeting, cost control, risk assessment, contract management, and supplier management. Fluent in English (both spoken and written) for business and technical communication. Proficiency in a second European language (e.g., German, French, Norwegian) is a plus. Strong cross-cultural communication and coordination skills, capable of effectively engaging with local governments, property owners, supervisors, and subcontractors on site. High sense of responsibility and resilience under pressure; willing to travel frequently. Candidates with overseas government or industry partnership resources that facilitate fast-track project approvals and support are preferred. XPENG offers: An interesting, unique and very varied job at XPENG A job with an incredibly large contact surface both internally and externally An attractive salary package incl. pension and with the possibility of a bonus To be involved in the growth of an existing EV brand in Europe Next steps: To comply with GDPR, we can’t process your personal data without your given consent. Therefore, please apply directly via LinkedIn portal so that our team can proceed further. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see: https://www.xpeng.com/policy As part of our application process, certain positions at our company require a pre-employment screening to ensure the reliability and integrity of our employees. This screening is a standard procedure and may include components such as a Criminal Background Check from your current or previous country of residence over the past five years. Additionally, the process may involve an integrity questionnaire, verification of identification, diplomas, work experience, and consultation of the central insolvency register. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this important matter, as it helps us maintain the high standards expected by our team.
